**Sofaly** · build {BUILD} · commit {COMMIT}

Your TV, simple again: an ad-free home for Google TV and Android TV. The full tour is on [sofaly.tv](https://sofaly.tv)
and in the [README](https://github.com/ChrnX0/sofaly#readme).

### What changed

<!-- auto:changes -->
- Home in rows: each category in a row of large cards, the focused row moves to the top and the art of the focused card fills the background, under a dark veil
- Row fine-tuning: ready themes (Default, Cinema, Showcase, Minimal), export and import your theme, 2 or 3 lines per category, status bar, clock and text size
- Row background: the focused art, changing on its own with a fade, colours taken from the art and an adjustable shadow
- Card menu: open, app shortcuts, reorder, lock with PIN, media controls, open at power on and details
- Open at power on: an app opens by itself when the TV turns on or wakes up, after a wait you choose
- Idle mode: after a while, the home dims and shows a large clock (time and opacity adjustable); going back twice can open the screensaver
- One standard on every screen: art under a dark veil, boxes instead of pills and lines, a cream focus border with an orange icon, graphite background with no blue
- Radio, Podcasts and Games in rows of cards; covers without a photo in graphite with the initial
- Panel on the phone and the computer follows the TV: graphite boxes, cream focus and orange only on what is active
- Texts no longer teach keys: remote hints left every screen, in every language (the keys are in Help)
- Control from outside the home: the paired phone controls the TV over the internet through the Sofaly server, encrypted end to end
- Other homes: link two TVs with a code (or from the phone) and check the numbers on both; Continue on another TV and Watch together reach those homes
- Help other homes: with your yes (asked once, at the end of the welcome), Sofy sends the Sofy network only what the consent screen lists and gets signed recipes, which for now only check
- Sofy alerts your phone when the TV needs you, and the phone gets back into the panel without asking for the PIN again
- Share to TV: send a link, video or photo from the phone straight to the TV
- House night, freeze watch and server health: the TV notices when something freezes or slows down and says so in the panel
- The welcome offers to bring data from another TV or a backup; new “What Sofy knows” screen, with Forget
- Moon phase everywhere: a clear night shows today's moon on the sleeping home, the quick panel and the forecast
- House reminders in one list, and family messages stay in view; simple mode gets a strip at the top
- TV search finds settings and the podcasts you follow; the panel shows when the TV asks for text
- Report a problem privately, straight to Sofaly
- Health: the full-disk forecast is no longer scared by a large app just installed; measuring app launch always returns to Settings
- Sturdier: the home no longer crashes when apps finish loading after it was recreated, and a channel list that fails says so instead of loading halfway
- USB drive: formatting is blocked when the backup cannot read every folder
- Contrast, text size and colours checked by a test on every screen; licences in English; cards that are not cut
- The app and panel complete in more languages: missing texts translated in 26 languages
<!-- /auto:changes -->

### Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `sofaly-launcher.apk` | 32-bit (`armeabi-v7a`), e.g. Chromecast with Google TV. Downloader code **6566820** |
| `sofaly-launcher-arm64.apk` | 64-bit (`arm64-v8a`). In Downloader: `sofaly.tv/download-arm64` |
| `one-tv-celular.apk` | The Sofaly phone app (Android 10+): finds your TVs, opens the panel, remote, volume keys, Share to TV |

Each APK has a `.sha256` file next to it. Already installed? Sofaly updates itself from here.
